selection: Reuse I2 S1 development inputs; d2 R2/R4 weak/strong DR information contrast. Two sigma endpoints of a bounded low/moderate-noise comparison. Exclude 0.03/0.10, R5, other drifts and anchorB before outcomes to focus on S0 prior/convergence.
calibration_prior: same zero-mean Gaussian calibration standard deviations as each frozen I2 config; no initial pose prior
gauge: DR initial pose exactly gauge0; RANGE anchor horizontal0, initial position(rho,0), delta uniform(-pi,pi]
range_initialization: p(rho|z0) proportional to area rho times first Gaussian range likelihood; consumed once, later updates start k=1

prior_sensitivity.note: halfnormal alternatives are deliberate sensitivity priors, not claimed no-information defaults

domain_sensitivity.note: relative to max(abs(dz),z0); numerical domain check only; baseline integrates unbounded rho with tail control

randomness: sensor/range files reused; PF seed namespace20261013,2301; prior/domain variants use common random draws; reference repeats independent; batch namespace separate

reference_necessary_checks.note: passing necessary checks alone cannot exclude unvisited modes

sensitivity_interpretation: Report initial rho distributions and paired terminal calibration shifts for every prior/domain variant. No robustness claim unless numerical accuracy AND reference convergence pass; MC spread is a confounder.
target: same conditional measured-input Gaussian static-calibration model as I2 S1; exact SE2; no calibration jitter/inflation/PSD repair; B0 generator mismatch retained
scoring: Calibration error gauge-invariant. No absolute XY RMSE. Empirical 95% marginal intervals and calibrated joint ellipse with invalid rank marked. Seed-level summaries, 4 seeds exploratory.
